bm_suit_pd3teddy_desc: The cops aren't ready for a heister dressed as Teddy Moo. Every time they pull the trigger, they'll feel a pang of guilt over shooting at their favorite childhood cartoon. Plus, no one wants to be caught executing Teddy Moo while the news cameras are rolling. that's a Public Relations nightmare waiting to happen. Nostalgia can make the best body armor!
